conventions.divergenceComparison: draftSave first-only vs be.validate.DRAFT; fe.publish vs be.validate.PUBLISH after codeMap; validateFloorRules vs validate at each policy ignoring id-check codes (ADR 136); fe.schema acceptance vs absence of INVALID_FIELD_TYPE/INVALID_CATEGORY in be.validate.DRAFT; index.java vs index.sql
conventions.expect: derived from the brief's verdicts and its 'Contracts settled after the capture' section; index lists the admitted floor indices, boundary violations, and the entity rows those floors yield (digits-only ids, enhanced gifts at their base)
